privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Veil collects no data about you: no accounts, no cookies, no analytics, no ads.
privacy.device: Your settings, saved places and downloaded regions. They never leave this browser and are deleted together with the site's data.
privacy.hosting: The server of this site ({host}) sees your IP address and which parts of the map are loaded — from that, one can tell which areas you look at. Downloaded regions load from your device and remove these requests.
privacy.search: The search service ({host}) sees your IP address and what you type. With “Prefer results near the map area” on, it also gets an approximate area (about 10 km); with “What’s here?”, the point you chose. Turn on “Search only when I press Enter” to send less.
privacy.location: Your location is requested only when you tap “Show my location”. It stays on this device: it is never sent to a server and never put into the page address.
privacy.links: Links to OpenStreetMap open a third-party website.
privacy.selfHost: Veil can run on your own server, with your own map files and search. Then nobody else is involved.
